method.formula: normalize(z + beta * B U V^T B^T z)
method.objective: temperature-scaled listwise softmax with same-target cross-donor positive and all other targets as negatives
method.basis: randomized right singular basis fitted only on the current non-panel fitting partition and permitted teacher donors

protocol.invalid_k562_outer_reason: PerturbMatch is a reanalysis of the K562 assay
protocol.baseline_reproduction: saved panel queries use exp064's original all-mapped-coordinate normalization followed by VCC-coordinate blocking and must match an independent raw-bank reconstruction within 1e-6
protocol.learned_feature_separation: all adapter bases, weights, selection metrics, nulls, and source clusters use retained-coordinate-safe artifacts: train_query for fitting/selection and panel-row cluster_query for clustering; both exclude both target panels during centering, norm calibration, and whitener restriction
protocol.outer_truth_open_policy: verify and open only after the non-panel pre-gate, exact final real/null weights, and fold-specific source-query clusters are frozen
protocol.null_plan: one pre-generated per-replicate target-priority realization induces and freezes fit, fit+tune, and all-target permutations
protocol.fit_cache: nine candidate-invariant normalization/basis/projection/base-score contexts reused without changing epochs or optimizer state
protocol.candidate_batching: the 36 candidates at each rank share batched linear algebra while retaining separate parameters and Adam state
protocol.candidate_selection: exact macro tune PDS maximization among eligible candidates; only exact floating-point ties use rank, beta, regularization, temperature, then key as a deterministic ordering
protocol.source_clustering: separately staged panel-row query using retained-coordinate-only centering, norm calibration, and principal whitener restriction; all VCC and historical target coordinates remain excluded
protocol.kolf_confirmation: required and supported by pinned artifacts

selection.rule: exactly maximize macro tune PDS among candidates nonnegative in every outer-role x held-teacher cell and under 10 degrees; only an exact floating-point tie uses the deterministic lower-complexity ordering

held_truth.representation: raw donor delta centered over every donor perturbation

cluster_bootstrap.method: fold-specific source-query target-cluster bootstrap; independently resample each fold's clusters, then average fold means

cluster_dependence.method: fold-specific diagnostics on source-only query clusters

permutation_null.method: repeat the complete candidate grid and selection under each response-norm-decile label permutation, freeze that null's selected final weights before panel truth, then evaluate
